earnings.title: WARNER MUSIC GROUP CORP. REPORTS RESULTS FOR FISCAL FOURTH QUARTER AND FULL YEAR ENDED SEPTEMBER 30, 2026
highlights: Total revenue increased 7%, the same in constant currency
Digital revenue increased 13%, the same in constant currency
Net income was $179 million versus $109 million in the prior-year quarter
Basic earnings per share for both classes was $0.34 compared to $0.21 in the prior-year quarter
Adjusted earnings per share was $0.55 compared to $0.53 in the prior-year quarter

quotes.text: Our Q4 and full-year results demonstrate the success of a multi-year, transformational strategy that sets a new bar for WMG.
quotes.by: Robert Kyncl, CEO, Warner Music Group

quotes.text: With revenue reaching an all-time high, led by double-digit subscription streaming growth and margin expansion ahead of our expectation, we delivered against our financial goals in 2026.

items.heading: Aligned Organizational Structure to Enable Greater Global Impact.
We may be unable to compete successfully in the highly competitive markets in which we operate, and we may suffer reduced profits as a result.
Our prospects and financial results may be adversely affected if we fail to identify, sign and retain recording artists and songwriters and by the existence or absence of superstar releases.
If streaming adoption or revenue grows less rapidly or levels off, our prospects and our results of operations may be adversely affected.

We are substantially dependent on a limited number of digital music services for the online distribution and marketing of our music, and they are able to significantly influence the pricing structure for online music stores and may not correctly calculate royalties under license agreements.
Our business operations in the United States and in some foreign countries subject us to trends, developments or other events which may affect us adversely.
